description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating three token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers three times, adding twelve {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating three 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beast tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers three times, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
